claim: Quantify the response of the directly evaluated atomic LTE candidate on the inherited photon cells. This conditional sensitivity calculation does not require or assert that its native population/emission certification passed.
decision: Determine whether switching to the direct-T independent atomic spectrum changes the response materially and whether its source-grid/time error is below1e-3. Do not interpret model difference as TOPS interpolation error or replace the canonical same-EOS verdict.
method: Reuse collective Maxwell/RPA kernel and saved TOPS response. Build scattering matrix once, change only absorption diagonals and material exchange. LTE source is chi*B by declared model, NOT the native emission column.
